news.headline: Two Seas Capital Discloses 9.1% Stake in Nektar Therapeutics
news.summary: Hedge fund Two Seas Capital raised its passive stake in Nektar to roughly 3.09 million shares, or 9.1% of shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026. The increased position follows the July launch of Nektar's Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $40.6 million (EPS of -$1.23, beating consensus by $0.74) on revenue of $10.1 million, with R&D spend up 30.8% year-over-year on Phase 3 costs. Cash and investments stood at $1.02 billion with no debt, extending runway into Q3 2028, while management confirmed the July initiation of Phase 3 ZENITH AD and plans for a Phase 3 alopecia areata study in early 2027.

news.headline: Analysts Raise Price Targets on Nektar After Q2 Beat
news.summary: Following the Q2 earnings beat, Piper Sandler raised its price target on Nektar to $192 (from $105, Overweight) and Wedbush raised its target to $95 (from $70, Neutral). Wall Street price targets now range from $80 to $192, with a consensus around $153.

news.headline: Nektar R&D Chief's Performance-Based Options Vest After ZENITH AD Launch
news.summary: Nektar's board determined that performance-based vesting conditions were satisfied for 16,500 stock options held by Chief R&D Officer Jonathan Zalevsky, tied to the company hitting its Phase 3 program milestones. The filing followed the July 21 start of the ZENITH AD trials.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Coverage Initiated at Canaccord Genuity with Buy Rating
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash began coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and a $153 price target. The initiation came days after the company launched its pivotal Phase 3 program, drawing renewed Wall Street attention to the stock.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two global registrational Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in patients 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis who have not previously used biologics or JAK inhibitors. A third trial (ZENITH AD-3) for treatment-experienced patients is also planned, with initial Phase 3 readouts targeted for mid-2028 and a first BLA filing planned for 2029.

catalysts.label: EADV Congress 2026 (Vienna) oral presentations
catalysts.detail: Nektar has two oral presentations on rezpegaldesleukin at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology Congress, covering durability data in atopic dermatitis (Dr. Thomas Bieber) and 52-week alopecia areata results (Dr. David Rosmain, session Oct 1).

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar's next quarterly financial results release, expected roughly early-to-mid November 2026 based on prior quarterly cadence.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to begin a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata.

catalysts.label: TrialNet Phase 2 Type 1 diabetes data
catalysts.detail: Initial data are expected from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in new-onset Stage 3 type 1 diabetes.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 ZENITH AD initial topline readouts
catalysts.detail: Management's guided timeline calls for the first Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis readouts in mid-2028.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin
catalysts.detail: Nektar's Phase 3 program is designed to support the company's first biologics license application for rezpegaldesleukin, targeted for 2029.

pulse: Nektar is now fully committed to rezpegaldesleukin as its lead (and effectively sole near-term) asset, having dosed the first patients in its pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis program in July 2026 and guiding to a 2029 BLA filing. The Q2 2026 print showed a narrower-than-expected loss, rising R&D spend, and a $1.02 billion cash position (runway into Q3 2028) following an April equity raise, which drew fresh sell-side coverage (Canaccord's Buy initiation) and higher price targets (Piper Sandler to $192) plus increased hedge-fund stakes (Two Seas Capital to 9.1%). With Wall Street consensus solidly Buy-rated and implying roughly 100% upside from current levels near $75-76, the stock's trajectory now hinges on execution through the multi-year Phase 3 readout window, with EADV Congress data presentations in late September/early October as the next visible checkpoint.
